title: Minkah Fitzpatrick up to full participation at Jets practice

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Minkah Fitzpatrick up to full participation at Jets practice
sources.description: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn gave safety Minkah Fitzpatrick a really good chance of returning to the lineup against the Bears this Sunday earlier this week and Fitzpatrick is moving in the right direction as the game gets closer.
